issue.title: delay before take_off

comments.body: What mode are you in when you do this? And have you asked in the ArduPilot forum or Discord? I'd expect people to be able to help you there. And it doesn't sound like a mavsdk problem as such, so I'm not sure what to say.

I installed MAVSDK from the v3 branch and everything works successfully, before that, another developer installed MAVSDK, switching for some reason to the v2.12.2 tag, which caused this problem. But although it is strange for me personally, before that the drone could take off in any mode, now it is on this version, if it is in Guided mode, then it only makes an arm and does not take off, and if you change the mode to Stabilized before that, then the takeoff is successful.
Ok thanks for the feedback. I'll close this issue then.
